src/browser-multiplayer-identity.ts.name: Multiplayer room identity
src/browser-multiplayer-identity.ts.description: Derives a napplet's soy-rtc/1 multiplayer name from its verified manifest; local files get none.

src/browser-multiplayer-services.ts.name: Multiplayer services
src/browser-multiplayer-services.ts.description: Builds the WebRTC and CVM services for one napplet window, sharing a transport identity only within that window.

src/browser-multiplayer-settings.ts.name: Multiplayer settings page
src/browser-multiplayer-settings.ts.description: Restores and saves the host's multiplayer settings, then reloads the page so every connection restarts together.

src/browser-webrtc-profile.ts.name: soy-rtc/1 profile
src/browser-webrtc-profile.ts.description: Implements the soy-rtc/1 WebRTC profile: reliable JSON channels signalled over Nostr with a window-private key.

src/browser-webrtc.ts.name: WebRTC rooms
src/browser-webrtc.ts.description: Backs NAP-WEBRTC with real browser peer connections signalled over Nostr relays, capped at 4 sessions per window, 8 peers and 64 KB messages; available only while a signer is active.

src/cvm-discovery.ts.name: CVM server discovery
src/cvm-discovery.ts.description: Reads what the developer typed and looks up public, signed ContextVM server and tool announcements on relays.

src/cvm-family-store.ts.name: Saved CVM families
src/cvm-family-store.ts.description: Saves and restores the developer's chosen ContextVM server families in host storage, ignoring corrupt entries.
